documents.title: Speech Of Chairman / Video Recording / Presentation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Amal Ltd reported its consolidated and standalone revenue for the financial year ended March 31, 2026, driven primarily by significant price increases in its primary raw material, sulphur. The company maintained a debt-free status with an increased cash surplus, while profit before tax declined due to the inability to fully absorb surging input costs. Management outlined key operational mandates, including improving existing operations, advancing capital expenditure projects, and developing internal leadership pipelines. The company also progressed its planned diversification into allied products while maintaining its core sulphur-based product foundation. Amal Ltd published its annual report for the financial year 2024-25, highlighting significant improvements in both standalone and consolidated financial results driven by higher price realisations and capacity utilisation.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that two CapEx proposals amounting to 6 crore are underway to invest in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility.
capex_expansion.quote: One, to invest in upgrading the existing manufacturing facility – two CapEx proposals of ` 6 cr are underway.

margins_costs.quote: The price of the key raw material Sulphur, varies from month to month.

capital_allocation.claim: The company wiped out its remaining carried forward loss of 14 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: It wiped out its remaining carried forward loss of ` 14 cr which at peak was ` 56 cr.

capital_allocation.claim: The company repaid its entire borrowing and generated a cash surplus of 22 crore as on March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: It repaid its entire borrowing and generated cash surplus of ` 22 cr (as on March 31, 2025).

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a 10% dividend for consideration.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board recommended 10% dividend for your consideration, and we trust you will unanimously approve the same.
